mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect clear skies and a pleasant 77 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you are out tonight, keep an eye on the sky starting at 8:19 PM, when the space station will be visible for 6 minutes, moving from the southwest over Mount Horeb toward the east northeast in the direction of Fitchburg and Madison.

City Hall has published several notices for the upcoming November 2026 general election, including information on polling locations and public testing. Additionally, the engineering department continues to update its service reports, and residents are reminded that the Military Ridge State Trail is closed through mid-November for bridge construction.

There is plenty to do this week. Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness or head to Hop Haus Brewing for trivia. Tomorrow brings live music to both Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market this Saturday or catch the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in downtown Verona this Saturday.

Regarding the Verona Police Department weekly report, on Sunday, August 30, officers were notified of a past incident involving a school staff member. An investigation followed, and 34-year-old Halla Nelson was arrested on September 4 on a count of sexual assault of a child by a school staff member.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
